topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I stumbled upon a time capsule today, buried in the garden, and I can't shake the unease. It wasn't labeled, but there, inside, were old photos, faded letters, and a little trinket from my childhood. How did I forget burying this? I sift through the memories inside, each one echoing a past I thought I had put to rest. The weight of the capsule in my hands feels heavier than it should. I consider reburying it, untouched, as though I never found it, but I hesitate, wondering if I should have left well enough alone.
